rules.statement: The proper folio for the registration of a subsequent deed relating to part only of a land is still the original folio or a new continuation folio properly connected to the original, as required by Section 14 of the Registration of Documents Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: "If a deed relating to a particular land has been registered, then any subsequent deed relating to the same land is duly registered only if it is registered in the same folio as the first deed or in a folio maintained in continuation of the earlier folio; and the new folio is the proper folio only if cross references in both such folios clearly establish that the later folio is a continuation of the earlier one. There is no exception to this rule for a case in which a part only of a land is dealt with by a subsequent deed. The proper folio for the entry of such subsequent deed is still the original folio or a new continuation folio properly connected to the original."
